_scenario: E — ambiguous timestamp (must reject, not best-effort)
_note: Humanity v1's documented response shape always carries the trailing `Z` (UTC). This fixture captures a documented-shape regression: the vendor unexpectedly returns timestamps WITHOUT timezone information. Per humanityTimestampPolicy.asUtc (humanity_labor_adapter.dart lines 140-149), the framework's contract is that future API changes that drop `Z` MUST NOT silently default to local — the adapter rejects via tryFromMap returning null on DateTime.tryParse() of a naive timestamp (see lines 205-208).
